title: ChatGPT as Research Scientist: Probing GPT’s Capabilities as a Research Librarian, Research Ethicist, Data Generator and Data Predictor

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the models to estimate cultural associations between gendered word dyads and attributes (e.g., Art vs. Science, Home vs. Work, Math vs. Reading, Good vs. Bad) to compute simulated WEAT D-scores. Additionally, prompting the models to predict cross-country implicit and explicit gender-science/liberal arts stereotypes and correlating the predictions with real-world Project Implicit data.

Prompting the models to predict country-level explicit and implicit sexuality attitudes (e.g., preference for straight over gay individuals) and comparing these predictions against actual cross-cultural data from the Project Implicit International Dataset.

Prompting the models to predict country-level explicit and implicit age attitudes (e.g., preference for young over old individuals) and correlating the model's predictions with real-world cross-cultural Implicit Association Test (IAT) and survey data.
